adapter_gaps.rule: Translate rich Node/v2 domain record to Rust typed NodeSemanticState with exact definition selector digests, components, scope, typed properties and forbidden collapses; fail on missing fields. No generic dictionary passthrough.
Project histories are not ontology events; construct and separately authorize exact ontology semantic/governance events before claiming canonical Ontology Cut.
Project/Product/Method semantic endpoint mappings require exact reviewed contracts and R08 outcomes.

business_system_bridge.assertion_binding: Exact alignment proposition and evidence revision
business_system_bridge.implementation_binding: Exact governed Implementation revision or explicitly labeled source symbol
business_system_bridge.rule: Source symbol discovery alone is observed material; missing alignment evidence is unresolved. No method, feature, capability or implementation collapse.

rules: Resolve identity AND exact version; version mismatch is unresolved.
Pending challenges are retained separately from admission, confidence, commitment and ontology lifecycle.
A resolved challenge never establishes general truth or new action authority.

claim_ceiling: Candidate mapping design only. No canonical ontology events, admitted profile, live service or complete repository coverage.

coverage.currentness: Check all selected source/control/profile/head bindings; changed or unverified claims are excluded from confirmed current paths.
coverage.mapped_rule: Exact revision, namespace, source bytes, type contract, independent posture axes and required joins resolve. Mapped means representation coverage, not verified domain truth.
coverage.partition_rule: Every selected subject is classified once; each unresolved/excluded row has exact identity, reason and closing task or intentional scope exclusion.
coverage.truncation: Partial with omitted frontier and continuation bound to the same source cut.

global_edge.authority_rule: Projection is read only. Never creates an authoritative Typed Relation or expands global endpoint signatures.
global_edge.endpoint_rule: Resolve both exact endpoint revisions and preserve direction, qualifiers, evidence, lifecycle and admission. Invalid/unresolved endpoints remain diagnostics outside confirmed traversal.
global_edge.historical_mode: May show historical/withdrawn relations with explicit effective posture; exclude from current confirmed paths.
global_edge.source: Exact admitted Typed Relation revision, resolved Relation Kind and exact ordered pair in selected effective cut.

history_domains.ontology_governance: Exact ontology governance event cursor and event-set digest; each governance event joins an exact semantic event identity/digest/cursor
history_domains.ontology_semantic: Exact ontology semantic event cursor, canonical event-set digest and stream heads
history_domains.project_governance: Exact Project governance history identity, cursor and digest
history_domains.project_semantic: Exact Project semantic history identity, cursor and digest
history_domains.rule: No cross-domain cursor substitution. Missing ontology events mean no Ontology Cut or lifecycle state has been established.

local_edges.status: candidate closed profile; require exact profile admission before governed ontology-event use
local_edges.value_rule: Each qualifier is an exact byte binding or an explicitly scoped source value. Text labels are never authority or executable checks.

node_identity.encoding: Length-prefixed UTF-8 fields hashed with SHA-256; labels never contribute. Original byte source and selected schema selectors remain separate provenance bindings.
node_identity.historical_rule: Keep distinct exact revision representations; never silently resolve a historical version to latest.

scope.selection: Exact selected admitted/historical subject inventory; explicit candidate inputs remain candidate. Never all repository files.
